title: Future Travel Credit Vouchers Produced by a Cancelled Vacation Package
content:
A future travel credit is issued for the value the cancelled package still carried after the penalty and the administration charge have been withheld, and carries an expiry set by the credit validity term of the product that produced it. Vouchers arise only from Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products and are governed by the product that produced them.

## Issue

A future travel credit voucher is issued only when no voucher has already been issued against the same package. The package's own ledger settles that: where a line issuing a future travel credit already stands against the package, a second is not issued, whatever the moment or the traveller it would be issued for.

A product whose credit validity term is zero issues no voucher at all, and the cancelled value is forfeited.

The voucher is issued in the name of the lead traveller and is transferable only where the producing product makes credits transferable.

## Redemption

A voucher is applied only while the package record stands at quoted or deposit held. A voucher is applied to the price of a new package before any discount and never to the deposit alone, and the balance is collected in the ordinary way.

## What a voucher is not

The value on a voucher is never paid out in money, and an unused voucher is never extended beyond its expiry.

## Condition and result

| What the records show | Result |
| --- | --- |
| No voucher yet issued against the cancelled package, and the producing product carries a credit validity term | a voucher is issued for the value the package still carried after the penalty and the administration charge |
| A voucher already issued against that package | no further voucher is issued against it |
| The producing product's credit validity term is zero | no voucher is issued, and the cancelled value is forfeited |
| The new package stands at quoted or at deposit held | the voucher may be applied to its price |
| The new package stands anywhere else in its life | the voucher is not applied |
